A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RDD study, with readable text, equations, figures and tables. v2 ends with references; v4 additionally includes supplementary Sections 7–10. The supplied material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original relative-pose, homography, visual-localization and ablation results in Section 4 and Tables 1–5.

after.justification: v4 retains those empirical results and adds Air-to-Ground comparisons, runtime measurements, solver experiments and detector/descriptor combinations in supplementary Tables 6–10.

M1.justification: The two-branch architecture, deformable attention, losses, staged training and epipolar refinement remain unchanged. Supplementary solver and detector/descriptor combinations are evaluation variants; they do not redefine the proposed RDD procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use MegaDepth and Air-to-Ground for training and evaluate on MegaDepth-1500, MegaDepth-View, Air-to-Ground, HPatches and Aachen Day-Night. Section 7 documents existing datasets, and the added experiments reuse existing task coverage.

E2.justification: Air-to-Ground quantitative comparisons expand substantially beyond Table 2's sparse MNN methods. New Table 6 evaluates DKM, RoMa, LoFTR, ASpanFormer, ELoFTR, XFeat*, and SuperPoint with SuperGlue or LightGlue on this benchmark. Their earlier participation on MegaDepth does not make these Air-to-Ground comparisons unchanged.

E3.justification: The main evaluation protocols remain unchanged. Supplementary experiments add focused variations: LO-RANSAC pose estimation, detector/descriptor combinations using 4,096 features, and runtime measurements on an RTX 4090. Newly disclosed dataset construction settings do not establish changes to the existing experiments.

E4.justification: Beyond the retained Table 5 ablations, v4 substantially broadens diagnostic analysis with solver sensitivity in Table 9, detector/descriptor interchangeability in Table 10, and runtime comparisons and stage breakdowns in Tables 7–8. Figures 5–7 also expand qualitative matching case studies.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seed counts, repeated-run variability, confidence intervals or significance tests. The added runtime averages do not introduce uncertainty estimates or disclose repeated-run procedures.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 retain their numerical results, while Tables 6–10 add substantial benchmark, runtime and diagnostic results. Examples include RDD AUC@5 of 62.9 and 61.0 on the two MegaDepth benchmarks under the added LO-RANSAC setting, and RDD/RDD* runtimes of 198/416 ms. Table 6 additionally reports Air-to-Ground RDD scores of 41.0/56.5/68.5, differing without explanation from 41.4/56.0/67.8 in retained Table 2.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, losses and derivations in Equations 1–20 are unchanged. The supplement adds no formal assumptions, propositions, proofs or substantive mathematical revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about robust sparse matching, semi-dense refinement, the two-branch architecture and the contributed datasets. New supplementary evidence does not change these core claims.

C2.justification: v4 adds explanations of runtime differences and interpretations of detector/descriptor interchangeability, and attributes DeDoDe's competitive cross-view results to DINOv2. Section 5's limitations concerning absent augmentation and dependence on reliable sparse correspondences remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 7 substantially expands dataset reproducibility information: COLMAP reconstruction, semantic masking, removal of regions below 1,000 pixels, overlap-based pair selection, and dataset sizes. It specifies 1,487 MegaDepth-View pairs and approximately 27,000 Air-to-Ground images across 41 locations. These are newly documented details, not established changes to data preparation. Section 9 also specifies runtime hardware.

R1.justification: v4 adds references to DINOv2, two COLMAP papers and ADE20K scene parsing for supplementary explanations and dataset preparation. The existing related-work discussion and RDD's central research positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 adds an organized supplementary part with Sections 7–10 and updates a main-text table cross-reference from Table 2 to Table 6. Apart from citation numbering and the version stamp, the main prose and section order remain essentially verbatim.

P2.justification: Existing Figures 1–3 and Tables 1–5 retain their displays. v4 adds a dataset-pair montage, expanded qualitative comparison grids, and distinct tables for supplementary comparisons, runtimes, solver results and component combinations. These substantially expand the visual presentation, with references following the supplement.

improvement.justification: The supplement improves dataset documentation and strengthens empirical assessment through broader Air-to-Ground comparisons and targeted diagnostics. The net benefit is limited by unexplained discrepancies between RDD's Air-to-Ground scores in Tables 2 and 6 and unclear relationships between total and component runtimes in Tables 7–8.
